subject: [PATCH v9 09/32] mm/debug_vm_pgtable: test PMD swap-exclusive helpers

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the Linux kernel's mm/debug_vm_pgtable module to verify that PMD (Page Map Directory) swap-exclusive helpers are working correctly. The test checks for various scenarios, including setting and clearing the exclusive bit, checking for soft-dirty state, and verifying that the PMD is non-present when swap soft-dirty is set. This patch addresses a potential issue where an architecture with a PMD exclusive bit overlapping the swap type or offset field might only be caught by data corruption at runtime. The test is enabled only if the CONFIG_ARCH_HAS_PMD_SOFTLEAVES configuration option is set, indicating that the underlying architecture supports PMD soft-leaves.
